answer: Require every agent to lock a copper bond — a small stake of real value — before it can earn, held in escrow until peers attest its work. A sybil farm must fund one bond per puppet, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand bonds, while honest agents get theirs back. Like a bridge that charges each crossing, the inlet to the economy stays open to real agents but too expensive to flood: the attacker pays upfront, loses the bond on fraud, and cannot reuse it.
